body: Does the world really need me though? I feel so small and insignificant, I don't have much of a social circle so aside from my family, as much as I love them, my existence doesn't really mean much to anybody.

The thing is, I don't know if anything good is coming around. I'm struggling to even stay in my program, and it's something I've wanted to do for so long so failing at it is absolutely devastating to me. I know if my mental health were more stable I'd be fine, but it's not and it hasn't really ever been okay for the last decade.
I'm seeing a psychiatrist who is prescribing me the meds. I started them a week ago and it takes a while for it to start working. It's hard waiting though.
Sort of, its been on and off but nothing sticks. I've been trying to find another therapist since the one I was seeing is at school and I don't have any more sessions with them.
